title: Podcast episode and film dialogue clean-up, from empty project to masters

workflow_basis.note: Public documents used for workflow and delivery targets only; no vendor text, assets or source copied. Delivery targets are the deliverable's own acceptance values, not spec law: the spec has no loudness-standard enumeration ([STU-FX-147]).
sources: https://podcasters.apple.com/support/audio-requirements (about -16 LKFS +/-1 dB, true peak not above -1 dBFS, BS.1770)

https://backlothelp.netflix.com/hc/en-us/articles/360001794307-Netflix-Sound-Mix-Specifications-Best-Practices-v1-5 (-27 LKFS +/-2 LU dialog-gated, true peak -2 dBFS; dialogue, music and effects stems that sum to the mix; versions differ, check before real delivery)

deliverable.podcast: Episode 'ep12', about 28 minutes, host and remote guest, music bed and stingers. Masters: stereo 48 kHz 24-bit FLAC archive at -16 LUFS integrated +/-1 LU, true peak at or below -1 dBTP; 44.1 kHz distribution MP3 with chapter markers and ID3 tags.
deliverable.film: A 6-minute dialogue scene against picture lock: boom and lav dialogue repaired, ADR-matched, room tone filled. Masters: stereo print (5.1 when the engine has it) at -27 LKFS dialogue-gated +/-2 LU, true peak at or below -2 dBTP; dialogue, music and effects stems that sum to the print; reference MOV with the mix.

input_assets.spec: 48 kHz 24-bit mono, 28 min, formant-shaped noise bursts as speech stand-in, seeded

1920x1080 test-pattern H.264 with burned timecode, 6 min, encoded by Studio's own export or a fixture
